messages:
Asha L.: throwing a quick idea into the ring — what if we replace the full-role modal with an inline 'compact ladder' per row that expands on focus, keeping the matrix context visible? Figma proto: https://www.figma.com/file/mini/compact-matrix :sparkles:

Ethan R.: like it. main concerns: keyboard order while expanding, and how to signal billing impact (increment seat vs no change).

Priya S.: Copy thought: two distinct actions inside the picker: 'Set role' (in-org change) and 'Invite & set' (sends email). keep verbs tight.

Sam O.: Accessibility: overlay should be focus-trapped, have role=dialog, and each option needs aria-pressed and an accessible label like 'Set role to Power for Jordan (no email)'.

Asha L.: good. visual rule: selected pill needs 4.5:1 contrast; locked SSO roles show a lock icon and are aria-disabled with tooltip explaining enforcement.

Ethan R.: for audit/logging, emit structured events: event: 'role.update', method: 'inline-picker'. include actor, target, from, to. we'll deep-link that to audit rail.

DesignBot: sample audit JSON:
```
{"event":"role.update","actor":"asha.l@redwood.com","target":"maria@acme.com","from":"Guest","to":"Full","method":"inline-picker","ts":"2025-05-01T09:15:00Z"}
```
Use that id to open the right-hand audit filter.

Priya S.: also add undo toast: 'Changed Maria to Full — Undo' (aria-live polite). Undo button must be keyboard-focusable and visible in high-contrast.

Sam O.: note for dev: add 8-10s grace window before billing finalization for seat-affecting changes, and surface the billing chip: '+1 seat (billed)'. aria-describedby should link to billing details.
